title: New! Downtown Riverfront Condo with Pool!
description:
Riverfront Condos is a unique complex located downtown along the Cumberland River with excellent views of the river and the downtown skyline!  Perfect location for out of town guests on vacation or for locals to enjoy the "downtown" experience with ease! Excellent for folks in town or business as well with plenty of restaurants, shops, and bars near by.  Swimming pool, free parking, outside grill, firepit, gym & laundry access for all guests! Rates are non-negotiable.

The space
This is the third floor, end unit condo with no elevator. Pool and Riverview from the living room window, downtown skyline view from the front porch.

Guest access
Swimming pool (April 1 - Oct 31), gym, laundry facilities, firepit, patio & deck with grill.
